status.connected: Notion connected (agents can search via MCP)
status.not_connected: Notion not connected for this account

rail.empty: Paste a Notion link to pin it here. Saved pages appear in the chat @ picker.
rail.mention_hint: In the chat bubble, type @ and pick a Notion page to insert a link chip.

embed.hint: If the embed is blank, Notion may block framing — use Open in Notion.
embed.blocked: Notion blocked the embedded view. Open it in a new tab instead.
embed.fallback_title: Open Notion in a new tab
embed.fallback_body: Notion blocks embedding its app inside Multica (browser shows “refused to connect”). Use Open in Notion for the full workspace, pin public *.notion.site links in the rail, or connect Notion so agents can search via MCP.
